manifest.name: chc5_xilinx_mono_fw
manifest.description: Xilinx-IP mono ISP for 4-lane 12-bit MIPI CSI-2 mono sensors up to 5568x3672: CSI-2 receive, raw crop, black-level correction, gamma, grey RGB and YUV, raw/RGB/YUV/mono pixel packing, 1080p60 HDMI output and PTP camera sync; no demosaic, no colour correction and no AE statistics.
